newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen refraining from open market operation.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen refraining from open market operation.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to stay out of the open market on Wednesday, as its add need looks to be met, analysts said.
Tuesday's operation of $1.8 billion of two-day system repurchase agreements was said to be enough to meet both Tuesday and Wednesday's add need -- seen at $2 billion a day.
But four-day system RPs are expected on Thursday.
Fed funds were at 5-7/16 percent, below the 5-1/2 percent target rate.
